## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `email-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Enable IMAP/POP3 access (Gmail example)

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your Gmail account. -->
2. Select the gear icon in the top-right corner, then select **See all settings**.
3. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Forwarding and POP/IMAP tab. -->
4. Under **IMAP access**, select **Enable IMAP**.
5. Under **POP download**, select **Enable POP for all mail**.
6. Select **Save Changes**.

## Step 3: Generate an app password (Gmail example)

1. <!-- manual: Go to your Google Account at [myaccount.google.com](https://myaccount.google.com). -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to Security › 2-Step Verification › App passwords. -->
3. Select **Mail** as the app and your device type.
4. Select **Generate**.
5. <!-- manual: Copy the 16-character App Password displayed. -->
